remarks:
MAJOR PRICE REDUCTION! Ready for your finishing touches! Discover the possibilities at 21 South Parkway Lot A, Java Lake! Whether you're looking for a relaxing seasonal getaway or a property to make your own, this charming seasonal home offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the beauty and recreation of the Java Lake area.

Featuring 600 square feet of living space, this cozy seasonal home offers 2 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, and an inviting open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area (19' x 17') with new laminate flooring, updated electrical, and lighting. The bathroom has also been recently updated. Sliding glass doors lead to a spacious, partially finished sun porch (37' x 7'), offering additional space to unwind, entertain, or enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Piping is already in place to accommodate a heating system of your choice, offering the potential for extended seasonal use or possible year-round enjoyment with additional improvements.

The exterior features charming cedar shake shingle siding and an asphalt shingled roof. An added bonus is that this offering consists of three parcels being sold as one parcel, creating a generously sized outdoor setting with extra space for gatherings, gardening, or simply relaxing and enjoying the fresh air. With access to Java Lake, opportunities for boating, fishing, kayaking, and other outdoor activities are close at hand.

With a major price reduction, recent improvements, three parcels being sold as one, and room to add your personal touches, this seasonal retreat is ready for its next chapter. Come explore the possibilities and imagine making your own memories at Java Lake!
